name: Tiroler Hof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Tiroler Hof in Kufstein**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Alpenvorland**. Our historic inn, nestled in the charming old town of **Kufstein**, invites you to experience the warm spirit of **Tirol**.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine—from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with apple compote to savory **Schlutzkrapfen** and crispy **Kaserspätzle**. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Tiroler Wein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from our own brewery.

After dining, relax in our cozy **Stüberl** or enjoy a stroll along the **Inn River**, where the majestic **Kufstein Fortress** stands as a testament to history. Whether you're exploring the **Zillertal** or the **Karwendel**, our central location makes us the perfect base for your adventures.

**Tiroler Hof**—where tradition meets modern comfort, and every guest feels at home. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
